The best Korean in town. 100%
May 2025 • Family
We felt like the food here was no worse than in Seoul’s itself. All other clients were Korean, which was a good sign. We walked in as the restaurant is a 10 minute walk from our hotel. We loved it. The service was good, we communicated mainly through google translate, which was fine.

"Seeing is believing" is a well-known saying, so don't believe Google's scores...
Jun 2024 • Friends
The restaurant had a Google rating of 4.9, so I thought it couldn't be wrong and I'd eaten Korean BBQ in Japan, so I went in. The customers were mostly Korean, and we were the only Japanese there. The beef ribs were just tough, and the pork was the same, so it didn't taste good at all. No matter what country you're from, people think that good things are good and bad things are bad, but what's with this bad taste? The Vietnamese staff had a good attitude.
